site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: WHO confirmed 8 cases and 3 deaths as of 08 May; vessel docked Canary Islands Sunday to allow passenger evacuation to home countries per The Week. En route Rotterdam with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse for full disinfection; company expects to determine future cruise schedule by end of week per AP News.

site.name: NEBRASKA
site.desc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC NQU received Dr. Stephen Kornfeld (Oregon oncologist, PCR-positive) after he assisted ill Hondius passengers aboard; a second symptomatic American also in biocontainment. 17 Americans quarantined in Omaha with two requiring biocontainment due to mild symptoms per The Daily Beast; CDC says widespread US transmission unlikely.

site.name: ILLINOIS
site.desc: Winnebago County resident suspected of contracting hantavirus after cleaning a rodent-infested property per The Daily Beast; health officials believe exposure via aerosolized rat urine or feces. Case assessed as unrelated to MV Hondius outbreak; local and state health authorities investigating.
